title: Лёва включает тирана  (Lyova Unleashes His Inner Tyrant)

segments.t: Taking Viktor Petrovich's advice to heart, mild-mannered Lyova suddenly explodes at the staff, barking at Vika to stay out of kitchen affairs and stripping the cooks of their bonuses. Stunned by his ferocious outburst, Senya, Fedya, and the rest of the crew immediately snap to attention.
Был бы на кухне шеф, вы бы работали.
Был бы на кухне шеф.
Вы бы работали.
Тут все работают.
Ты кого это сейчас так назвал?
Вообще, что вы лезете в дело кухни?
А ну-ка, вали в зал, курица!
За словами следи.
Не лечь во взрослый разговор?
Понял, мы без шефа работать не можем, да?
Хорошо, вот это вам шеф.
А все остальные лишаются премии.
Уроды воничи.
Let's walk back through the scene line by line.
Был бы на кухне шеф, вы бы работали.

'If the chef were in the kitchen, you would be working.' Barinov reminds Vika that if the were in the kitchen Vika would be working before the moment passes. Notice how he sticks to the formal "you", keeping a professional line between them.
Был бы на кухне шеф.
'If the Chef were in the kitchen.' Because if the Chef were in the kitchen, Vika treats the matter as settled.
Вы бы работали.
'You would all be working.' Explaining that Vika would all be working lays the cards on the table for Vika. Notice how he sticks to the formal "you", keeping a professional line between them.
Тут все работают.
'Everyone here is working.' Vika mentions that everyone here is working so Barinov sees what is at stake.
Ты кого это сейчас так назвал?
'Who did you just call that?' By asking who Vika just call, Barinov presses Vika for a straight answer.
Вообще, что вы лезете в дело кухни?

'Why are you meddling in kitchen business anyway?' Wondering why Barinov meddling in kitchen business anyway is cuts straight through the tension between Vika and Barinov. Even in the middle of the drama, she keeps the polite plural "you" that workplace Russian expects.
А ну-ка, вали в зал, курица!

'Get out into the dining room, you hen!' Insisting that Vika should get out into the dining room Vika hen shows Barinov is not backing down. Russian puts the key word right up front so his emotion lands on the first beat.
За словами следи.
'Watch your mouth.' Once Barinov should watch Barinov's mouth, Vika can finally tell Barinov what she means.
Не лечь во взрослый разговор?

'Do not butt into an adult conversation!' Asking whether do not butt into an adult conversation puts Vika right on the defensive. In Russian, he does not need helper words like "do" or "did"—rising pitch alone turns it into a question.
Понял, мы без шефа работать не можем, да?

'I see, so we cannot work without the Chef, right?' By seeing so they cannot work without the Chef right, Vika presses Barinov for a straight answer. In Russian, she does not need helper words like "do" or "did"—rising pitch alone turns it into a question.
Хорошо, вот это вам шеф.
'Fine, here is the Chef for you!' Declaring that fine here is the Chef for Vika brings Barinov's temper right to the surface.
А все остальные лишаются премии.
'And everyone else loses their bonus.' Saying that everyone else loses their bonus is how Vika sets the tone with Barinov.
Уроды воничи.
'You stinking freaks.' Between the work and the situation, Barinov gives Vika a quick, grounded response. Let's hear the full exchange one more time at natural speed.
Был бы на кухне шеф, вы бы работали.
Был бы на кухне шеф.
Вы бы работали.
Тут все работают.
Ты кого это сейчас так назвал?
Вообще, что вы лезете в дело кухни?
А ну-ка, вали в зал, курица!
За словами следи.
Не лечь во взрослый разговор?
Понял, мы без шефа работать не можем, да?
Хорошо, вот это вам шеф.
А все остальные лишаются премии.
Уроды воничи.

That wraps up this scene as following Barinov's advice, Lyova shocks the entire kitchen by screaming at Vika, smashing plates, and stripping the staff of their bonuses until everyone scrambles back to work. Until next time!
Пока!
